sc: Auguste's sapling is given during the Enlightened Journey quest by Auguste to grow into a willow tree in order to obtain willow branches to build the basket of the balloon for the Balloon transport system.
The branches can be cut off any Willow tree in a farming patch, or they can be bought on the Grand Exchange.
If the sapling is lost, another can be purchased from Auguste for 30,000 coins.
They can be found rarely while skilling in the Dream of Iaia.
The bathus chainbody is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The Bernie Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.
They are a very rare drop that can be obtained by killing black dragons, including the King Black Dragon and Queen Black Dragon.
Blue robe bottoms can be purchased at the Tree Gnome Stronghold from Rometti at his store, Fine Fashions, located north-east on the of the Grand Tree.
In the quest Dragon Slayer, an unfired bowl is required as one of four items in order to obtain Thalzar's map parts from the Oracle on Ice Mountain.
This amulet can be bought from the Rewards Trader for 6,500 Dungeoneering tokens, requiring 30 Attack and 21 Dungeoneering to purchase.

This amulet provides the third highest strength bonus of any neck slot item in free to play, it is outclassed by the amulet of zealots for damage and accuracy when using prayers, and the much easier to obtain Amulet of strength.
It is made by custom-fitting masterwork magic hat via the Master Crafter in the clothesmaking area of the Crafting Guild.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 elder rune bars and elder rune gauntlets + 1, requiring 1,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 2,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 elder rune bars and an elder rune off hand longsword + 1, requiring 2,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 4,000 Smithing experience.

sc: The demonic title scroll (obscured) is a scroll dropped by the demon boss in a Demon Flash Mob.
It is given to the player by Savant after using the Commorb v2 to scan the markings on the imposing doors in the newly discovered shrine underneath Witchaven.

Dragon pickaxes are very rare drops from chaos-aligned monsters on the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield (the soldiers of the Dwarven Black Guard do not count) after completion of Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf, and Chaos Giants after Birthright of the Dwarves.
They are also a possible reward from the Triskelion Treasures.

Highland kilt (purple, female).x: The purple highland kilt is part of the highland outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The medium portable skilling pack is an item that was introduced on 2 February 2015 and was available on Treasure Hunter from 20 February 2015 0:00 UTC to 23 February 2015 23:59 UTC and as a special reward from the 2016 Christmas Advent Calendar.
Prior to the Mining and Smithing rework on 7 January 2019, portable forges could be obtained, but these were replaced with luminite injectors.
Merethiel's stave is an item dropped by Solak at a rate of 1/500.

sc: The mining away teleport token is a Treasure Hunter reward available in the Buried Treasure promotion, first available from 8 November 2018.
It is also a possible drop from animation chests.
They can be purchased from the clothing store on Lunar Isle during or after the completion of the quest Lunar Diplomacy.
The muspah tail is a quest item given to the player by Jhallan, a Zarosian Mahjarrat, as a trophy for the young Fremennik boy Erjolf during The Tale of the Muspah.
This necklace trinket can be found just north of Aggie's house in Draynor Village.
Off-hand blurite crossbows can be made through the Fletching skill at level 16; a player must first cut an oak stock for the crossbow from oak logs, granting 8 Fletching experience.
Overload salves (6) (unfinished) are partially-made overload salve potions, made by Granny Rowan with a tier 3 Botanist's Workbench constructed in Fort Forinthry.

These unfinished overload salves are made from all the same ingredients as normal (and the same level 97 Herblore requirement), but the ingredients must be noted, and the resulting unfinished potions are stackable.

q: A mixture of 4 items, either caskets or oysters
sc: Oysters may be found while fishing with a big fishing net, granting 10 Fishing experience, while panning at the Varrock Dig Site, foraged by a granite crab, or obtained as drops from a number of monsters.
While it cannot be obtained by players, it can be seen wielded by non-player characters such as Hari and Tarquin and the icon is present in the Woodcutting skill guide.
A paddle can spawn during one of the puzzles of the Desperate Times quest.
Paul's lamp is a post-quest reward from Gower Quest.
It is obtained by talking to Paul at the Life altar after the quest.

Pharaoh's sandals (purple).x: The purple pharaoh's sandals is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Purple pirate leggings can be looted from pirate implings.
The plain smithing urn (full) is an item made by filling a plain smithing urn while smelting or superheating bars.
Prayer XP lamp is a reward item given upon completion of the Vessel of the Harbinger quest.
The item was awarded to a single auction winner as part of GameBlast 2018.
A raw gnomebowl is created by using a gnomebowl mould with Gianne dough.
Raw mackerel is a fish that can be caught with a big net at any Net/Harpoon fishing spot with level 16 Fishing, granting 20 Fishing experience.
After completing In Aid of the Myreque quest, up to 10 raw mackerel can be purchased from Aurel's Supplies in Burgh de Rott for 26 coins.
A re-roll token (medium) can be redeemed to re-roll rewards from a reward casket (medium).
It can be purchased from the Treasure Trails Reward Shop for 50 points, or obtained as a possible reward from a treasure trail.
A red banana is a type of banana found on a Red Banana Tree on the north-western side of the Ape Atoll.
You are only allowed to pick one at a time, but more can be obtained through the drop trick.

Replica Dragon Plateskirt.x: The Replica Dragon Plateskirt is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica dragon plate armour pack.

sc: The revenant drop enhancer is a reward from Deathmatch, purchasable for 200 Deathmatch points from the Deathmatch Reward Shop, or rarely from the Wilderness shared loot table.

Roosters are chickens that can be obtained by checking a chicken egg (unchecked), purchasable from the Farmers' Market for 25 beans, or a rooster (unchecked), which Adam Antite can retrieve for the player.
The rubber chicken is an item found in Zemouregal's lost property chest on the of the palace in New Varrock.
The rune berserker shield is a reward that can be purchased with 300 tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
The Saradomin staff is a type of God staff obtained after completing the Mage Arena minigame.
Shadow Cat is a cosmetic override outfit that could be purchased from Solomon's General Store for 360 RuneCoins, or 324 RuneCoins for members.
The Shard of Suffering is a two-handed magic weapon override unlocked by activating a Shard of suffering weapon token.
The Smithing crate (large) is an item that can be won from Squeal of Fortune which contains a variety of smithing materials; there is also a chance for an additional reward.
The Solite Armour is a cosmetic override outfit originally unlocked by exchanging 2,500 Solite sigils as part of the The Equinox promotion on Treasure Hunter.
It can be bought from any Slayer Master for 650 coins.

Spooky pumpkin stacks.x: The spooky pumpkin stacks is a cosmetic furniture pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 200 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 180 RuneCoins for members.

Stegoleather boots is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.

The superior spined armour set was a reward from Bounty Hunter & Deathmatch Reward Shop containing all pieces of superior spined armour.
The components of the armour is currently created by combining Fremennik equipment patches with spined armour pieces.

It could be bought from the Loyalty Programme Shop for 57,000 Membership Loyalty Points.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.
The tanned cave crawler skin is a quest item obtained by killing a cave crawler during the Fur 'n Seek quest, using a bag of salt on its skin, and tanning it.

Templar Greaves.x: The Templar Greaves are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by looting the coffins in the Tomb of the Fallen after completing The Death of Chivalry.

sc: While the hood is bought with the skillcape, it is not needed to perform the emote associated with it; the skillcape is the only essential item.

Thorvar's bucket (2016 Christmas event).x: Thorvar's bucket is obtained from Thorvar's bag when all the other items have been added to the bag. It must be used to catch Salty Claws, with the result that the bucket will become Salty Claws in a bucket.

Tidal Staff.x: The Tidal Staff is a cosmetic override for a two-handed Magic weapon that can be unlocked by redeeming a Hydro Token. The token is a possible reward from a summer piñata loot bag which can be obtained by breaking a personal summer piñata. The token can also be won on Treasure Hunter during the 2018 Summer Pinatas promotion.

The brown villager armband is a hand slot item that can be purchased with trading sticks from Gabooty's Tai Bwo Wannai Cooperative.
A Vorago shard is a companion pet that could be purchased from Solomon's General Store prior to its removal on 13 April 2026.
It is dropped by vultures.
After the miniquest is completed you can no longer obtain this as a drop.
A Waiko teleport is a teletab that can be purchased for 5 chimes from Boni's Waiko Reward Shop.

Weapon poison+++ flask.x: The weapon poison+++ flask is a potion flask containing six doses of weapon poison+++. It is created by using weapon poison+++ potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

sc: Like many holiday items, players could only have one Wintumber tree at a time; if lost or destroyed, they could obtain another from Diango in Draynor Village.

As one of the only members' holiday items (the others are the Icicle crown, the Hourglass, Mackers, and Sparkles), it used to be impossible to obtain the tree if the player did not complete the event as a member.
